1.content:
# VMware relationships (VMware extension)
**ESXi host -> VM -> OneAgent host.** VM -> ESXi comes from `runs_on[dt.entity.vmware:host]`; VM -> OneAgent host from the OneAgent host's `same_as` link. Entity cells are clickable. Coverage = powered-on VMs that have a OneAgent host linked.
Uptime: ESXi from `vmware.host.uptime`; VMs from the extension metric if collected, else the classic integration's `dt.entity.virtualmachine` uptime (matched on name), else OneAgent `dt.host.uptime` - `uptime_src` shows which.

2.title: ESXi hosts
2.query:
fetch `dt.entity.vmware:host`
| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entity.name
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| summarize hosts = count()

3.title: VMs
3.query:
fetch `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
| fieldsAdd vm = entity.name, vm_power_state, vm_connection_state, `dt.entity.vmware:host` = runs_on[`dt.entity.vmware:host`]
| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entityName(`dt.entity.vmware:host`)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd same_as
    | fieldsFlatten same_as
    | expand `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | filter isNotNull(`same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`)
    | fields oa_host_id = id, oa_host = entity.name, oa_vm_id = `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:oa_vm_id, fields:{oa_host_id, oa_host}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd has_oneagent = isNotNull(oa_host_id), powered_on = endsWith(lower(toString(vm_power_state)), "on")
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| filter in("*", array($PowerState)) or in(vm_power_state, array($PowerState))
| summarize vms = count()

8.title: Powered-on VMs with uptime
8.query:
fetch `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
| fieldsAdd vm = entity.name, vm_power_state, vm_connection_state, `dt.entity.vmware:host` = runs_on[`dt.entity.vmware:host`]
| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entityName(`dt.entity.vmware:host`)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd same_as
    | fieldsFlatten same_as
    | expand `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | filter isNotNull(`same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`)
    | fields oa_host_id = id, oa_host = entity.name, oa_vm_id = `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:oa_vm_id, fields:{oa_host_id, oa_host}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd has_oneagent = isNotNull(oa_host_id), powered_on = endsWith(lower(toString(vm_power_state)), "on")
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| filter in("*", array($PowerState)) or in(vm_power_state, array($PowerState))
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_0 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_0 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_0, drops_0}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.sys.uptime.latest`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_1 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_1 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_1, drops_1}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.sys.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_2 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_2 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_2, drops_2}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd vm_lc = lower(vm)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.virtualmachine
    | fieldsAdd uptime
    | fieldsAdd cls_name = lower(entity.name), cls_up_s = toDouble(uptime) / 1000000000.0
    | dedup cls_name
  ], sourceField:vm_lc, lookupField:cls_name, fields:{cls_up_s}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries u = max(dt.host.uptime), by:{dt.entity.host}
    | fieldsAdd oa_up_s = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(u))
  ], sourceField:oa_host_id, lookupField:dt.entity.host, fields:{oa_up_s}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd uptime_raw = coalesce(up_raw_0, up_raw_1, up_raw_2, cls_up_s, oa_up_s), reboots_tf = toLong(coalesce(drops_0, drops_1, drops_2, 0))
| fieldsAdd uptime_src = if(isNotNull(up_raw_0) or isNotNull(up_raw_1) or isNotNull(up_raw_2), "extension metric", else: if(isNotNull(cls_up_s), "classic integration", else: if(isNotNull(oa_up_s), "OneAgent", else: "none")))
| fieldsAdd uptime_hours = uptime_raw * (1.0 / 3600.0)
| fieldsAdd uptime_days = round(uptime_hours / 24, decimals: 1)
| fieldsAdd last_reboot = if(isNull(uptime_hours), null, else: now() - duration(toLong(uptime_hours * 3600), "s"))
| fieldsAdd reboots_tf = coalesce(reboots_tf, 0)
| fieldsAdd rebooted = coalesce(uptime_hours < toDouble($RebootWindow), false)
| filter powered_on
| summarize vms = countIf(isNotNull(uptime_hours))

13.title: ESXi host summary
13.query:
fetch `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
| fieldsAdd vm = entity.name, vm_power_state, vm_connection_state, `dt.entity.vmware:host` = runs_on[`dt.entity.vmware:host`]
| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entityName(`dt.entity.vmware:host`)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd same_as
    | fieldsFlatten same_as
    | expand `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | filter isNotNull(`same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`)
    | fields oa_host_id = id, oa_host = entity.name, oa_vm_id = `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:oa_vm_id, fields:{oa_host_id, oa_host}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd has_oneagent = isNotNull(oa_host_id), powered_on = endsWith(lower(toString(vm_power_state)), "on")
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| filter in("*", array($PowerState)) or in(vm_power_state, array($PowerState))
| summarize vms = count(), powered_on = countIf(powered_on), with_oneagent = countIf(has_oneagent), by:{ `dt.entity.vmware:host`, esxi_host }
| fieldsAdd `Coverage %` = if(powered_on > 0, round(100.0 * with_oneagent / powered_on, decimals: 0))
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.host.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:host`}
    | fieldsAdd h_up_0 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up))
  ], sourceField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, fields:{h_up_0}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.host.sys.uptime.latest`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:host`}

  ], sourceField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, fields:{h_up_1}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd esxi_uptime_days = round(coalesce(h_up_0, h_up_1) / 86400.0, decimals: 1)
| fieldsAdd esxi_last_reboot = if(isNull(esxi_uptime_days), null, else: now() - duration(toLong(esxi_uptime_days * 86400), "s"))
| fieldsAdd esxi = record(entityId=`dt.entity.vmware:host`, displayName=esxi_host, dim="dt.entity.vmware:host")
| sort vms desc
| fields esxi, esxi_uptime_days, esxi_last_reboot, vms, powered_on, with_oneagent, `Coverage %`

| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entityName(`dt.entity.vmware:host`)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd same_as
    | fieldsFlatten same_as
    | expand `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | filter isNotNull(`same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`)
    | fields oa_host_id = id, oa_host = entity.name, oa_vm_id = `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:oa_vm_id, fields:{oa_host_id, oa_host}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd has_oneagent = isNotNull(oa_host_id), powered_on = endsWith(lower(toString(vm_power_state)), "on")
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| filter in("*", array($PowerState)) or in(vm_power_state, array($PowerState))
| lookup [
    timeseries s = avg(`vmware.vm.cpu.num_cores`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd num_cores = round(arrayAvg(s), decimals: 1)
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{num_cores}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_0 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_0 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_0, drops_0}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.sys.uptime.latest`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_1 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_1 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_1, drops_1}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.vm.sys.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_2 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_2 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`, fields:{up_raw_2, drops_2}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd vm_lc = lower(vm)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.virtualmachine
    | fieldsAdd uptime
    | fieldsAdd cls_name = lower(entity.name), cls_up_s = toDouble(uptime) / 1000000000.0
    | dedup cls_name
  ], sourceField:vm_lc, lookupField:cls_name, fields:{cls_up_s}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries u = max(dt.host.uptime), by:{dt.entity.host}
    | fieldsAdd oa_up_s = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(u))
  ], sourceField:oa_host_id, lookupField:dt.entity.host, fields:{oa_up_s}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd uptime_raw = coalesce(up_raw_0, up_raw_1, up_raw_2, cls_up_s, oa_up_s), reboots_tf = toLong(coalesce(drops_0, drops_1, drops_2, 0))
| fieldsAdd uptime_src = if(isNotNull(up_raw_0) or isNotNull(up_raw_1) or isNotNull(up_raw_2), "extension metric", else: if(isNotNull(cls_up_s), "classic integration", else: if(isNotNull(oa_up_s), "OneAgent", else: "none")))
| fieldsAdd uptime_hours = uptime_raw * (1.0 / 3600.0)
| fieldsAdd uptime_days = round(uptime_hours / 24, decimals: 1)
| fieldsAdd last_reboot = if(isNull(uptime_hours), null, else: now() - duration(toLong(uptime_hours * 3600), "s"))
| fieldsAdd reboots_tf = coalesce(reboots_tf, 0)
| fieldsAdd rebooted = coalesce(uptime_hours < toDouble($RebootWindow), false)
| fieldsAdd virtualmachine = record(entityId=id, displayName=vm, dim="dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine"),
            esxi = record(entityId=`dt.entity.vmware:host`, displayName=esxi_host, dim="dt.entity.vmware:host"),
            oneagent_host = if(has_oneagent, record(entityId=oa_host_id, displayName=oa_host, dim="dt.entity.host"))
| filter powered_on and not has_oneagent
| sort esxi_host asc, vm asc
| fields esxi, virtualmachine, vm_power_state, num_cores, uptime_days, uptime_src

15.title: OneAgent hosts running on VMware
15.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fieldsAdd osType, same_as
| fieldsFlatten same_as
| expand `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
| filter isNotNull(`same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`)
| fieldsAdd vm_id = `same_as.dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
| lookup [
    fetch `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | fieldsAdd vm = entity.name, `dt.entity.vmware:host` = runs_on[`dt.entity.vmware:host`]
    | fieldsAdd esxi_host = entityName(`dt.entity.vmware:host`)
  ], sourceField:vm_id, lookupField:id, fields:{vm, esxi_host, `dt.entity.vmware:host`}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| lookup [
    timeseries u = max(dt.host.uptime), by:{dt.entity.host}
    | fieldsAdd oa_up_s = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(u))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:dt.entity.host, fields:{oa_up_s}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd uptime_days = round(oa_up_s / 86400.0, decimals: 1)
| fieldsAdd oneagent_host = record(entityId=id, displayName=entity.name, dim="dt.entity.host"),
            virtualmachine = record(entityId=vm_id, displayName=vm, dim="dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine"),
            esxi = record(entityId=`dt.entity.vmware:host`, displayName=esxi_host, dim="dt.entity.vmware:host")
| sort esxi_host asc
| fields oneagent_host, osType, uptime_days, virtualmachine, esxi
